why: The triangle turns 90 degrees clockwise from box to box: up, right, down, so the last one points left. The double line stays on the side opposite the point, so it is on the right side. Option 2 fits. Option 3 points right, which is the second box again.
trick: Follow the order of the boxes (left to right, then next row) and keep turning the same way.
